parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: $('Format answer').item.json.payload.chat_id, text: $('Format answer').item.json.payload.text.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/&/g,'&'), reply_markup: $('Format answer').item.json.payload.reply_markup }) }}

parameters.query: insert into subscribers (chat_id, lang, subscribed, updated_at) values ($1, $2, $3, now()) on conflict (chat_id) do update set lang = excluded.lang, subscribed = excluded.subscribed, updated_at = now();
